turns.q: Looking at “Place Order” specifically, what about its visual style — solid fill, color contrast, border, or label weight — fails to make it read as the primary action?

The fix: downgrade 'Continue Shopping' to a ghost button or a text link, something that reads as optional. And give 'Place Order' a solid fill color with real contrast so it's unmistakably the primary action. If those two things were right — 'Continue Shopping' quiet, 'Place Order' prominent — I'd have known immediately which was the right one without any hesitation.
